item.title: Natural and Safe Ways to Treat Arthritis
item.description: Some leading arthritis experts say the last thing people with arthritis should do is take prescription drugs. They say there are some safer, less expensive alternatives. And they may be more effective.

item.title: Shiite a Favorite for Iraqi PM Post
item.description: Iraq's dominant Shiite ticket now has a candidate for prime minister, making him the favorite for the post. It is uncertain what role Islam may play in the government if he is elected.

item.title: The Reality of Women in Combat
item.description: Women have been allowed to serve on Navy warships and combat aircraft since 1994. But now, the Army is under fire. It is accused of violating its own ban on putting females near the frontlines.
